chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Ibn Maḥbūb, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Sinān, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام:
Concerning a man whose right hand is paralyzed, or whose left is paralyzed, who stole, he said: “His right hand is cut off in every case.”

key_terms.أَشَلِّ: paralyzed or disabled in limb function
key_terms.الْيَدِ الْيُمْنَى: the right hand, the limb specified in the ruling
key_terms.تُقْطَعُ: it is cut off; the prescribed legal punishment is carried out
key_terms.عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ: in every case; under all the stated circumstances

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a thief has a paralyzed right or left hand?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the hadd punishment for theft in the case of a person with paralysis in one hand. Imam Abu ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام states that the right hand is to be cut in every circumstance mentioned.
